import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from scipy.special import ellipj, ellipk
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 9, "axes.labelsize": 10, "axes.titlesize": 11, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "axes.edgecolor": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "text.color": "#263238", "xtick.color": "#657786", "ytick.color": "#657786", "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "grid.color": "#E5EAE8", "grid.alpha": 0.7, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
dt, T = 0.08, 40.0 theta0, omega0 = 1.2, 0.0 steps = int(round(T / dt)) if not np.isclose(steps * dt, T): raise ValueError("Total time must be an integer multiple of the time step.") t = dt * np.arange(steps + 1)
def rhs(y): return np.array([y[1], -np.sin(y[0])])
explicit = np.empty((steps + 1, 2)) symplectic = np.empty_like(explicit) rk4 = np.empty_like(explicit) for trajectory in (explicit, symplectic, rk4): trajectory[0] = [theta0, omega0]
for n in range(steps): # Explicit Euler: both derivatives use the old state. explicit[n + 1] = explicit[n] + dt * rhs(explicit[n])
# Symplectic Euler: kick, then drift using the updated velocity. q, p = symplectic[n] p_new = p - dt * np.sin(q) symplectic[n + 1] = [q + dt * p_new, p_new]
y = rk4[n] k1 = rhs(y) k2 = rhs(y + 0.5 * dt * k1) k3 = rhs(y + 0.5 * dt * k2) k4 = rhs(y + dt * k3) rk4[n + 1] = y + dt * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4) / 6
def energy(y): return 0.5 * y[:, 1]**2 + 1 - np.cos(y[:, 0])
E0 = 0.5 * omega0**2 + 1 - np.cos(theta0)
# Analytical libration solution for the supplied initial conditions. k = np.sin(theta0 / 2) m = k**2 t_exact = np.linspace(0, T, 6001) sn, cn, dn, _ = ellipj(ellipk(m) - t_exact, m) exact = np.column_stack(( 2 * np.arcsin(np.clip(k * sn, -1, 1)), -2 * k * cn ))
colors = { "exact": "#657786", "explicit": "#C66B4E", "symplectic": "#2A9D8F", "rk4": "#33658A", }
fig, (ax_phase, ax_energy) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.2, 4.0)) fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.095, right=0.975, bottom=0.255, top=0.745, wspace=0.32)
fig.suptitle("Simple pendulum: numerical integrator comparison", fontsize=13, fontweight="semibold", y=0.978) fig.text( 0.5, 0.903, r"$\ddot{\theta}+\sin\theta=0$" " | " r"$g/l=1$" " | dimensionless time", ha="center", fontsize=9 ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.852, r"$\theta(0)=1.2$ rad" " | " r"$\dot{\theta}(0)=0$" " | " r"$\Delta t=0.08$" " | " r"$T=40$", ha="center", fontsize=9 )
ax_phase.plot( explicit[:, 0], explicit[:, 1], color=colors["explicit"], linewidth=1.5, label="Explicit Euler", zorder=2 ) ax_phase.plot( symplectic[:, 0], symplectic[:, 1], color=colors["symplectic"], linewidth=1.3, linestyle="-.", label="Symplectic Euler", zorder=3 ) ax_phase.plot( rk4[:, 0], rk4[:, 1], color=colors["rk4"], linewidth=1.8, label="RK4", zorder=4 ) ax_phase.plot( exact[:, 0], exact[:, 1], color=colors["exact"], linewidth=1.2, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), label="Exact", zorder=5 ) ax_phase.set_title("a Phase trajectory", loc="left", pad=10) ax_phase.set_xlabel(r"Angle, $\theta$ (rad)") ax_phase.set_ylabel(r"Angular velocity, $\dot{\theta}$ (scaled)") ax_phase.margins(x=0.05, y=0.08)
ax_energy.plot( t, energy(explicit), color=colors["explicit"], linewidth=1.8, label="Explicit Euler" ) ax_energy.plot( t, energy(symplectic), color=colors["symplectic"], linewidth=1.5, linestyle="-.", label="Symplectic Euler" ) ax_energy.plot( t, energy(rk4), color=colors["rk4"], linewidth=1.8, label="RK4", zorder=4 ) ax_energy.axhline( E0, color=colors["exact"], linewidth=1.2, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), label="Exact", zorder=5 ) ax_energy.set_title("b Mechanical energy", loc="left", pad=10) ax_energy.set_xlabel(r"Time, $t$ (dimensionless)") ax_energy.set_ylabel(r"$E(t)$ (dimensionless)") ax_energy.set_xlim(0, T) ax_energy.set_xticks([0, 10, 20, 30, 40]) ax_energy.margins(y=0.08)
for ax in (ax_phase, ax_energy): ax.grid(True, linewidth=0.6) ax.set_axisbelow(True) ax.tick_params(direction="out", length=3, width=0.7)
handles, labels = ax_energy.get_legend_handles_labels() order = [3, 0, 1, 2] fig.legend( [handles[i] for i in order], [labels[i] for i in order], loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.105), ncol=4, frameon=False, fontsize=9, handlelength=2.6, columnspacing=1.6 ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.075, r"$E(t)=\frac{1}{2}\dot{\theta}^{2}+1-\cos\theta$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9 ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.025, "Angle is unwrapped. Nonlinear Euler energy growth is not necessarily exponential.", ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#657786" )
